summary: Emergency lookout photographed in November 1938; the association places it in Hardin County and lists it as a gone platform, while the archive caption calls it a tower. No source describes it today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association, which classes it as a platform; the archive caption calls it a tower.

events.note: National Archives photograph dated November 1938, captioned Hicks Emergency L.O. Tower in the Secondary Lookout System.

evidence.supports: Emergency lookout tower in the Secondary Lookout System (archive caption)
evidence.quote: Original caption: Hicks Emergency L.O. Tower. Secondary Lookout System.

evidence.supports: Photograph is part of Forest Service records held by the National Archives
Archive place record: Shawnee National Forest, Pope, Illinois
Association list: Hardin County, platform, gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The association lists a platform, while the 1938 archive caption calls it a tower. The record keeps the association's platform classification; the story says the two descriptions differ.

The archive place record gives Pope, Illinois, at coordinates about 26 km west of the association's Hardin County point. The record keeps the association's coordinates, since they are the lookout list's own point for this site.

sources.title: Photograph of Hicks Emergency Lookout Tower (NARA, record 2128274)

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one archive photograph, one association line and one lookout-site page with no detail. Kind (platform vs tower) and location (Hardin County vs Pope, Illinois, roughly 26 km apart) conflict across sources and are unresolved. No construction date, staffing or agency source beyond the Shawnee heading on the lookout-site page. The NARA photograph is public domain; I did not capture a direct image URL, so no photos entry was added. No source describes the site today.
